reports.title: The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with our interim condensed consolidated financial statements (unaudited) and the notes thereto included elsewhere in this report.

lines: The facility is expected to be drawn upon delivery of each vessel in separate tranches of $22.0 million each with drawdowns expected between the fourth quarter of 2027 and the first quarter of 2029.

In addition, $1.9 million of amortization related to prior service cost and net loss is expected to be reclassified to “Other (expenses)/income, net” during the twelve-month period ending September 30, 2027.
